        "snippet": "You can transfer your old Provident Fund (PF) account to your new one online through the EPFO Unified Portal.",

      {
        "type": "heading",
        "snippet": "Prerequisites"
      },
      {
        "type": "list",
        "list": [
          {
            "snippet": "Ensure your UAN (Universal Account Number) is active."
          },
          {
            "snippet": "Check that your KYC (Aadhaar, Bank Account, and PAN) is linked and verified in the portal."
          },
          {
            "snippet": "Make sure the Date of Exit from your previous employer is updated in the system."
          }
        ],
        "reference_indexes": [

        ]
      },
      {
        "type": "heading",
        "snippet": "Step-by-Step Online Transfer Process"
      },
      {
        "type": "list",
        "list": [
          {
            "snippet": "Log in to the EPFO Unified Member Portal using your UAN and password."
          },
          {
            "snippet": "Go to the top menu, click on Online Services, and select One Member – One EPF Account (Transfer Request)."
          },
          {
            "snippet": "Verify your personal details and current employment PF details."
          },
          {
            "snippet": "Scroll down to enter your previous establishment's Member ID or UAN, then click Get Details to load the old PF account information."
          },
          {
            "snippet": "Select the previous PF account you wish to transfer."
          },
          {
            "snippet": "Choose either your previous or current employer to attest and submit the claim form."
          },
          {
            "snippet": "Click Get OTP to receive a verification code on your Aadhaar-registered mobile number, enter the OTP, and click Submit.",
            "reference_indexes": [
              0,
              1,
              2,
              3
            ]
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        "type": "paragraph",
        "snippet": "Once submitted, you will receive a tracking ID. The employer or EPFO field office will verify the request, and the funds will usually reflect in your new account within 7 to 10 days.",

          4
        ]
